newsitem.title: TURKEY: Eighteen die, 33 injured in Turk motorway crash.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen die, 33 injured in Turk motorway crash.

text.p: A motorway pile-up involving seven lorries, one van and a car killed 18 people and injured 33 in southern Turkey on Sunday, state-run Anarolian news agency said.
It said workers travelling in the back of one of the trucks fell onto the road after it was struck from behind by another lorry on a motorway between Pozanti and Tarsus.
A fuel tanker then crashed into the two trucks, crushing the men lying on the road. Three more trucks, a van and a car then smashed into the wreckage causing further damage.
Twelve of the dead have yet to be identified, the agency said.
Turkey has one of the highest rates of highway deaths in the world.
